name: Variant Swatches
user_goal: Merchant configures, store-wide and per variant option (Color, Size, Material,...), how that option is displayed on the storefront widget — theme default dropdown vs. a color/image swatch (custom-configured or auto-pulled from Shopify's own variant data) — independent of any single offer or product.

actors.permission_observed: Portal access, left-nav item alongside Manage offers/Translations/Analytics; no finer-grained permission/role split documented in source.
Storefront visitor viewing a product detail page; no auth required to see the variant picker widget.

entry_points.path: Variant swatches table row > "Customize" button > /apps/staging-bk-volume/variant-swatches/setting/<OptionName> ("Setting Variant Option" page)
entry_points.precondition: At least one variant option row exists in the table, i.e. variants have already been synced from Shopify.

entry_points.path: Storefront product detail page (PDP) for a product that has a variant option
entry_points.precondition: Product has a variant option; swatch type for that option may or may not have been configured (both states render the same way today per KB-022/KB-023).

entry_points.path: Quantity Break offer (discount-offers object) > per-offer "Display settings" card > "Variant display" section > "Allow customers to choose different variants for each item" checkbox
entry_points.precondition: Merchant is editing a Quantity Break offer — cross-feature entry point from the discount-offers object, not owned by this feature.

capabilities.name: Browse and sync the store-wide variant option list
capabilities.description: Merchant opens the standalone, global "Variant swatches" Portal page and, if no variant data has ever been synced, sees an empty state with explanatory copy and a "Sync variants" button; clicking it pulls all available variants/variant values from Shopify into the app (with a loading state) and populates a table of variant options (one row per option name, store-wide, not scoped to one offer or product).

capabilities.name: Configure a variant option's display/swatch type
capabilities.description: From the variant option table, merchant clicks "Customize" to open a dedicated "Setting Variant Option" page (not a modal) where a "Swatch type" dropdown offers 5 choices (Default dropdown, Custom color dropdown, Custom image dropdown, Variant color dropdown, Variant image dropdown). The 2 "Custom..." types expose a per-variant-value customization table (HEX color picker row, or image upload row); the 2 auto-source "Variant..." types pull directly from Shopify's own variant color/image data with no per-value table, confirmed via live tooltip text for the color variant. Variant values are matched by exact, case-sensitive string.

capabilities.name: Shopper sees the configured display on the storefront widget
capabilities.description: On the storefront PDP, the variant option is intended to render as either the theme's default dropdown or a visual color/image swatch, per the merchant's configuration from the capability above. (Expected shape only — see risks[] for the confirmed defect in the actual rendering of this capability.)

capabilities.name: Cross-feature: Quantity Break per-item variant picker ("Variant display")
capabilities.description: Quantity Break (a feature of the discount-offers object) has its own per-offer "Display settings" card with a "Variant display" section, distinct from but directly referenced by this feature. That section exposes exactly 2 checkboxes ("Allow customers to choose different variants for each item" and "Hide theme variant picker") and is specific to Quantity Break — Multibuy and Wholesale Pricing offers have neither the checkbox nor the section. Enabling the first checkbox makes the Quantity Break offer's own Preview render an inline per-pack-item variant picker (native <select> dropdowns, one pair per item slot, using mock values unrelated to the offer's real trigger product) directly in the tier UI — not via any link/button out to this feature's own swatch-config page.

state_transitions.to: Variant swatches page: populated variant option table
state_transitions.condition: merchant has not yet synced any product variants

state_transitions.trigger: merchant clicks "Customize" on a table row

state_transitions.from: Setting Variant Option page: Swatch type = any option
state_transitions.to: Setting Variant Option page: Swatch type = Custom color dropdown Custom image dropdown Variant color dropdown Variant image dropdown
state_transitions.trigger: merchant selects a different value in the "Swatch type" dropdown

state_transitions.from: Quantity Break offer Preview: no per-item picker
state_transitions.to: Quantity Break offer Preview: inline per-pack-item variant picker shown (mock data)
state_transitions.trigger: merchant checks "Allow customers to choose different variants for each item" in Quantity Break's Display settings > Variant display section

confirmed_rules.statement: "Variant swatches" is a standalone, global Portal page, in the left nav alongside Manage offers/Translations/Analytics.
"Variant option" means the option name (e.g. "Color", "Size", "Material"), not a specific offer.
A variant option's storefront widget display has exactly 2 modes: default dropdown, or a color/image swatch (custom-configured or auto-pulled from Shopify's own variant data).
The swatch setting is store-wide and per-variant-option — not scoped to one offer or one product.

Variant Swatches is distinct from, but directly referenced by, Quantity Break's own per-offer "Variant display" settings (QVD-28); Quantity Break has its own per-offer "Display settings" card with a "Variant display" section.
The empty state on the Variant swatches page is shown only when the merchant hasn't yet synced any product variants.
Live labels (nav link, breadcrumb, page heading, card title) use "Variant swatches" plural, differing from the ticket mockup's singular "Variant swatch".
Empty state body text: "To customize how your product variants appear, you'll first need to sync variant data from your Shopify store.", with a primary "Sync variants" button.

Clicking "Sync variants" pulls all available variants/variant values from Shopify into the app; during sync the button goes disabled with a loading spinner and a "Loading variant swatches…" status line appears above the table.
Live variant option table columns are "Variant options" (plural), "Connected products", "Swatch type" (ticket said "Display type"), "Customize" — names differ from ticket QVD-46.

Clicking "Customize" navigates to a full dedicated page at /apps/staging-bk-volume/variant-swatches/setting/<OptionName>, with its own breadcrumb and a page heading matching the option name; no modal, overlay, or close/cancel/unsaved-changes-confirmation UI exists (differs from ticket QVD-46, which described a modal).
"Connected products" is shown again at the top of the Setting Variant Option page as a clickable count button (e.g. "11 products"), matching the table row.

The "Swatch type" dropdown on the Setting Variant Option page has 5 options, not 4 as the ticket said: Default dropdown, Custom color dropdown, Custom image dropdown, Variant color dropdown (not in the ticket at all), Variant image dropdown (renamed, now 5th/last instead of 2nd).
Selecting "Variant color dropdown" shows the live tooltip "Automatically assigns the existing variant colors", confirming it is an auto-source option parallel to "Variant image dropdown".
"Variant color dropdown" and "Variant image dropdown" have no per-value customization table — both are pure "pull from Shopify, no manual config" modes, unlike the 2 "Custom..." options.

For "Custom image dropdown", each per-value row has a disabled "Variant option" textbox plus either an existing image thumbnail with a "Remove image" button, or a "Choose File" + "Add image" button pair.
For "Custom color dropdown", each per-value row has a disabled "Variant option" textbox, a color-picker swatch icon, and a HEX textbox (placeholder #FFFFFF).

Enabling Quantity Break's "Allow customers to choose different variants for each item" checkbox live does NOT reveal any "Variant swatch settings" button nor an "Allow customer to choose variant for single-item offer" checkbox (both described by QVD-28) — neither element exists on live Quantity Break; the per-item variant picker is implemented as inline dropdowns in the tier UI instead.

Quantity Break's "Display settings"/"Variant display" section has exactly the 2 checkboxes already documented for Quantity Break ("Allow customers to choose different variants for each item", "Hide theme variant picker") — Multibuy and Wholesale Pricing offers have neither the checkbox nor any such section; it is Quantity-Break-specific, not a shared component across the 3 offer types.

Turning on "Allow customers to choose different variants for each item" makes the Quantity Break offer's Preview render a per-pack-item variant picker inline — each item slot within a multi-quantity tier gets its own pair of native <select> dropdowns, using mock values unrelated to the offer's real trigger product.
Variant values are matched by exact string, case-sensitive — "brown" and "Brown" are distinct rows with independently configurable images/colors, not merged.

observed_behavior.statement: On store test-vl-1 at time of check, Swatch type values seen on real rows were "Default dropdown" (most rows, never configured), "Custom color dropdown", "Custom image dropdown"; "Variant color dropdown" and "Variant image dropdown" exist as selectable options but no row was using them. Self-flagged by the source as a single-sample observation, not a general rule.
observed_behavior.note: knowledge_kind=INFERRED, confidence=LOW, single sample — do not generalize.

observed_behavior.statement: Variant option table pagination is documented as max 20 rows/page, but was not actually exercised — the test store only had 13 rows (one page), with "Previous"/"Next" both rendered disabled.

"Variant image dropdown" tooltip text ("Automatically assigns the existing variant images") is inferred by pattern-matching "Variant color dropdown"'s confirmed tooltip — not independently live-tested.

The Setting Variant Option page has a "Preview section" showing a mocked tier-card-style widget preview with the currently configured variant option's value as a label underneath — not documented in ticket QVD-46.

The absence of the "Variant swatch settings" button described in QVD-28 is hedged as either "never built" or "removed" — this is an interpretation of the UI not existing, not an independently live-tested fact about cause.

The Portal's data model (one row per option name, "Connected products" listing every product sharing that name) strongly implies swatch config applies globally per option name across all products sharing it, with no per-product override — but this has not been directly tested (e.g. configuring "Color" on one product and checking whether it applies to an unrelated product with the same option name).

dependencies: discount-offers object > quantity-break feature: Variant Swatches is distinct from, but directly referenced by, Quantity Break's per-offer "Variant display" settings (QVD-28) — see KB-005, KB-024, KB-026, KB-027. Multibuy and Wholesale Pricing offers have no such integration point.

Shared storefront rendering defect (KB-022): the same bug is also observed inside discount-offers' quantity-break (Display settings handoff, moot per KB-024/KB-027 coverage gaps) and wholesale-pricing-offer offer widgets (Wholesale widget on "Clay Plant Pot"). The discount-offers object-level shard (the object-level KB) carries its own side of this same cross-cutting bug via its own copy of claim — this profile's risks[] entry for KB-022 is the root-cause side (variant-swatches is the object actually at fault).

risks.risk: [KNOWN DEFECT] Configured color/image swatches do not render on the storefront. On product "Color swatch" (no app offer present), option "Color" configured with "Custom color dropdown" + real HEX values still renders as plain text radio pills on the theme's native variant picker — visually indistinguishable from an unconfigured option — and the configured HEX values leak as raw, unrendered JS-object-like text below the Add to cart/Buy it now buttons (e.g. `#eaabab { [Beige]: "#eaabab", },...`). Reproduced independently on product "White Ceramic Pot" with "Custom image dropdown" + real images (also no app offer present) — confirming the defect is not specific to one swatch type: 2 of 5 swatch types (Custom color dropdown, Custom image dropdown) confirmed broken with real configured data. Also reproduces inside the app's own offer widgets, not just the native theme picker: Wholesale widget on "Clay Plant Pot" renders its "Color" values (configured with real images) as plain clickable text labels, not swatches. The swatch config data pipeline computes values correctly; only the final "render as a visual swatch" step is broken.

[KNOWN DEFECT, direct consequence of the above] Because the rendering step never produces a real swatch on this theme, a variant value that was never configured renders identically to one that was configured but hit the rendering bug — there is no visual way to distinguish "configured but broken" from "never configured".

QVD-134 (Shopify app-review reported an error when saving in the "Variant Editor") could NOT be reproduced across 2 separate attempts: a QA "Cannot reproduce" comment on the ticket, and a live retest on 2026-09-11 (entering a real HEX value #3366FF into option "Type"'s "Custom color dropdown" field and saving — save succeeded with no error, value persisted after full page reload). Keep as a regression watch item only — do not treat as either a confirmed defect or a confirmed-working expected result.

unknown_areas.question: Does "Variant color dropdown" "Variant image dropdown" rendering (auto-sourced from Shopify-native variant colors/images) actually work on the storefront when a product has genuine Shopify-native variant color/image data, or does it share the same rendering defect confirmed for "Custom color dropdown"/"Custom image dropdown"?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Decides whether 2-of-5 or more/all 5 swatch types are affected by the KB-022 defect. The only live test attempted used a product with no native Shopify color/image data, so the result was inconclusive in both directions.

unknown_areas.question: If a merchant changes a variant option's swatch type after an offer using that option is already live on the storefront, does the storefront update immediately, or does it require a resync/republish?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Directly affects expected behavior for any config-change regression scenario; explicitly flagged in the source as not tested.

unknown_areas.question: Once the KB-022 storefront rendering defect is fixed, does Quantity Break's "Hide theme variant picker" checkbox correctly hand off rendering to this feature's own swatch widget, or does another gap exist in that handoff?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Currently described as "moot" in the source because nothing renders as a real swatch at all today; once the defect is fixed this interaction becomes testable with zero documented expected behavior.

unknown_areas.question: Do the per-item inline variant-picker dropdowns that Quantity Break's "Allow customers to choose different variants for each item" checkbox renders actually read and apply this feature's swatch configuration (color/image), or do they always fall back to plain native dropdowns regardless of configured swatch type?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Not tested because the real trigger product used in the live test had no variants. Plausible second surface for the same rendering defect, or entirely separate logic — currently unknown.

unknown_areas.question: Is the Portal's global, per-option-name scoping of swatch config (one config row applies to every product sharing that option name, no per-product override) actually confirmed, or only inferred from the data model's shape?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: If an undocumented per-product override exists, test coverage built on a 'global per name' assumption would be incomplete.

unknown_areas.question: What does the "Variant color dropdown" swatch type's rendering actually look like end-to-end on the storefront, given the only live rendering test attempted for it was inconclusive (no native Shopify color/image data existed on the test product)?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: One of the 5 total swatch types has no confirmed end-to-end rendered behavior documented at all, independent of the KB-022 defect question above.

unknown_areas.question: What happens to the variant option table's pagination (documented max 20 rows/page) once a store has more than 20 variant options — was never exercised because the test store only had 13 rows?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Pagination controls, boundary at row 20/21, and "Previous"/"Next" enabled-state behavior all remain unverified.

profile_relationships.relationship: cross-feature integration: Quantity Break's per-offer "Display settings" > "Variant display" section references this feature's variant-option concept (QVD-28), and reproduces the same storefront rendering defect (KB-022) inside its own offer widgets.
the storefront swatch-rendering defect (KB-022) reproduces inside Wholesale Pricing's own offer widget ("Clay Plant Pot"), confirming the defect is cross-cutting beyond this feature's own surfaces.
